name: Do Denver-area home conditions affect bathroom wall tile installation?

mainEntity.name: Do Denver-area home conditions affect bathroom wall tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Colorado's semi-arid climate, indoor heating in winter creates large indoor-outdoor humidity differentials, making vapor and moisture control behind bathroom tile critical. Homes in the Denver metro area, from Aurora to Parker, also frequently experience foundation movement due to expansive bentonite clay soils. This natural soil shift causes framing to move slightly over time. For lasting bathroom walls, installers must ensure framing is sturdy, backer boards are properly fastened with expansion gaps at corners, and changes of plane are sealed with flexible silicone rather than rigid grout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Expansive local soils and dry indoor winter conditions cause framing movement, requiring rigid backer boards and flexible silicone joints at corners to prevent cracking.
